stackDivergence.rationale: Task79 ports original matrix element_block_node_type, transpose, matrix copy, range copy and resize over genuine shared SoA vector and existing strings/blocks. Source block section order, early self/empty exits, range validation, clipping, partial writes, temporary default string construction/assignment/destruction, resize reset-before-clear and temp copy/swap are retained. Explicit string ADL callbacks and NativeValueType witnesses restore erased native template aliases, reusing actual SharedString members; primitive std::string value witnesses use existing JS string semantics, not a new string owner. Full unchanged original matrix/vector headers and genuine SharedString dependencies produce ordinary initialized full streams. Original canonical integer type is omitted in matrix-copy/transpose dispatch while range-copy accepts it; preserve and journal this asymmetry and consequent resize exceptions. Debug assertions, invalid iterator lifetimes, unrepresentable native casts/dimensions, ABI/concurrency/full QA remain unverified. Matrix block walks, actual ScMatrix/result/cell/document/edit/undo/input/view/UI remain required; foundation and broad parity flags false, next full81. Original matrix QA marker is unexecuted field/type context only.
